title: 2310. Sum of Numbers With Units Digit K

examples.explanation: One valid set is [9,49], as the sum is 58 and each integer has a units digit of 9. Another valid set is [19,39]. It can be shown that 2 is the minimum possible size of a valid set.
It is not possible to obtain a sum of 37 using only integers that have a units digit of 2.
The sum of an empty set is considered 0.
